caption:
"One of" means one. Simple as that.

In "one of the coasters," the subject has to be one. Cross out the of-phrase and match the verb to one.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: One of the coasters: singular or plural verb? Find the real subject first.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: One Of Takes a Singular Verb
youtube.description: Why "one of the" plus a plural noun still needs a singular verb. SAT-style practice question (original).
